_monitor_spec.armed_threshold: STOP if fewer than 30 iterations advance in any rolling 60-minute window, measured from the `Time =` lines of log.rhoSimpleFoam. 30 it/h is ~13% of the healthy rate and ~11x the observed stall rate, so it separates the two by an order of magnitude in both directions and will not fire on ordinary slowdown.
_monitor_spec.on_fire: STOP. Do not wait. Classify only AFTER stopping: read ExecutionTime/ClockTime from the log to separate box contention from a genuine stall, and read the pressure-solver iteration counts to separate plateau from oscillation. Sanaa's ordering is stop-then-classify, and it is the right one -- waiting is what cost 6.9 hours and ~2,500 core-min tonight for 18 iterations.
